english.title: Holder of workshop card divulge to / permit another to use a PIN used in connection with it - tachograph cards

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Passenger and Goods Vehicles Recording Equipment Tachograph Card Regulations 2006

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[divulged to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_
(B)_[permitted another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to use]_

the PIN used in connection with a workshop card of which you were identified as the holder
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 4(1)(g) and (4) of the Passenger and Goods Vehicles (Recording Equipment) (Tachograph Card) Regulations 2006.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
